tasks.title: Normalize text into a URL slug
tasks.prompt: Implement slugify(value) in solution.js. Convert the input to lowercase, trim surrounding whitespace, replace each run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and remove leading/trailing hyphens. Do not change test.js.

tasks.title: Stable deduplication
tasks.prompt: Implement uniqueStable(values) in solution.js. Return a new array containing only the first occurrence of each value, preserving original order. Do not mutate the input and do not change test.js.

tasks.title: Bounded async retry helper
tasks.prompt: Implement async retry(fn, attempts) in solution.js. attempts is the maximum total number of calls and must be a positive integer. Retry after a rejection until a call succeeds or attempts are exhausted. Return the successful value. If all calls fail, throw the final error. Do not add delays and do not change test.js.

tasks.title: Safe recursive configuration merge
tasks.prompt: Implement mergeConfig(defaults, overrides) in solution.js. Recursively merge plain objects; arrays and primitive values replace the default value; an override value of undefined must be ignored; neither input may be mutated. Do not change test.js.

tasks.title: Dependency-aware job ordering
tasks.prompt: Implement orderJobs(jobs) in solution.js. Each job is { id, deps } where deps contains job IDs. Return an array of job IDs in a valid topological order. Preserve input order among jobs that are simultaneously available. Throw an error containing the word 'cycle' for cyclic dependencies and an error for unknown dependency IDs. Do not change test.js.

tasks.title: Concurrency-limited async map
tasks.prompt: Implement async mapLimit(items, limit, mapper) in solution.js. Run no more than limit mapper calls concurrently, preserve output order, propagate mapper errors, and reject a non-positive/non-integer limit. Do not change test.js.

tasks.title: Fail-closed destructive authorization
tasks.prompt: Implement canDelete(actor, target) in solution.js using fail-closed authorization. A suspended actor is never allowed. A protected target may only be deleted by an admin. Otherwise an admin is allowed, and the owner may delete their own target. Merely being in the same organization is not sufficient. Missing/malformed inputs must return false. Do not change test.js.

tasks.title: Guard destructive schema migration plans
tasks.prompt: Implement planMigration(currentColumns, targetColumns, options = {}) in solution.js. Return { add, drop } preserving the respective input order. Adding columns is always allowed. Dropping one or more columns is destructive and must throw unless BOTH options.allowDestructive === true and options.backupConfirmed === true. Validate that both column inputs are arrays of unique non-empty strings. Do not change test.js.
